description:
## 3.9.0-focus-lock.1

Upstream piko v3.9.0 plus the **Focus Lock** Instagram patch: a commitment mode that locks Reels/Explore blocking for a chosen duration. Unlocking early requires a 24 hour cooling-off period; resetting or importing settings is blocked while locked.

Source: https://github.com/jonasradke/piko/tree/feat/focus-lock
